review.scope: Original and byte-identical copied source visually inspected at source size only
observations: All 32 full-body poses visible in an 8-column by 4-row grid, separated by transparent gutters.
Runtime demon identity retained: red skin/horns/tail, black hair and boots, green-and-gold jacket; not the poster elf.
Heading progression is readable, with true back and back-quarter torsos. E/W faces retain a slight three-quarter presentation rather than strict facial profiles.
Row 2 raises arms and tucks knees/boots; row 3 lowers arms and opens legs into feet-ready descent. Leg differentiation is subtler in rear-facing cells.
Row 4 bends deeper than anticipation, especially visible in front and profile cells; complete horns, tails, hands and boots remain within cells.
No bow, staff, weapons, effects, labels, grid marks, floor or shadow observed.
Head size appears broadly consistent across poses; source-size review cannot establish exact native-scale head/body or volume continuity.
limitations: Generated partial alpha is extensive. Lead-owned deterministic alpha thresholding and hidden-RGB cleanup are required; original pixels are untouched.
Exact directional angular separation, root registration, native scale, head/volume continuity and action readability require lead assembly/cross-review.
Four authored keys are not a complete animation cycle.
No runtime or human acceptance is inferred from source visual review.
